modmenu.summaryTranslation.inventory-per: An over-the-shoulder view of your inventory
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.inventory: Smoothly switch to a shoulder camera when opening the survival inventory. Keeps vanilla and resource-pack visuals, with movement provided by InvMove.
inventory-perspective.config.title: Inventory Perspective Settings
inventory-perspective.config.right.toolt: On: player on the left, inventory on the right. Off: player on the right, inventory on the left. An open recipe book uses the vanilla layout.
inventory-perspective.config.duration.to: Controls opening and returning camera motion. Set to 0 to disable animation. Configure movement and sneaking in InvMove.
